session_summary: Blue title bar: 'Bear Trend From The Open, Then Reversal Up'. A monthly-end bull trap at 5270 sells into a bear trend with a magenta dotted trend line to the day low near 5210, a parabolic wedge downtrend becomes a V-bottom, and a strong breakout at end of month lifts above the 5271 breakout line to the 5303 close.
